name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MultiPass.triangular_card_le
title: A triangular family of flips at a fixed cut needs as many row dimensions as flips
statement: Rows Y a (a : Fin m) at a fixed cut, linear residual maps L t, and for each a a column (t a, u a) at which the residual of Y a changes, while the residual of every earlier row Y a' (a' < a) at that column does not change. Then m <= card iota.
